ops.old: Flathead pieces dusted in seasoned flour, fried in hot oil until crisp, served with tartare sauce and lemon wedges. Cut 600g flathead fillets into fingers and pat dry. Season 100g plain flour with salt, pepper and a pinch of paprika. Dust the fish in flour, dip in 2 beaten eggs, then coat in 120g panko crumbs. Shallow fry in 1cm of oil at 180C for 2 minutes a side until golden. Mix 150g mayo with 1 tbsp chopped capers, 1 tbsp chopped gherkin, chopped parsley and a squeeze of lemon. Serve the fish with the tartare and lemon wedges.
